answer.rationale: Finance needs an 18% component-spend cut and the incumbent has already refused a price reopen, but the line is at 94% with no buffer and the contract dies in 14 days, so a full primary cutover would raise delivery risk even if last year's low-cost move (c2) was operationally clean. A guarded second source uses the vendor that can hit the mandate on its own while keeping the incumbent integration that stayed stable across cycles (c1); prior dual-source allocation held through a shortage (c3). Deferral is unsafe without auto-renewal; remaining volume and onboarding elapsed-time are still uncertain, so this stays a small test rather than a broad flip.
